headline: Budget measures with an electoral aim | less tax on 13th-month salaries
summary: The parliamentary majority has asked the government to reduce to 15% the tax on 13th-month salaries for lower incomes. The request is framed as an electoral budget measure.
why: Changes to income tax rules alter the public finances and household disposable income, which matters for the government's budget and domestic consumption.
